issues.problem: The white-hole theorem is existential in the parametrisation. It proves that SOME parabolic one-parameter family parabConj h θ fixing x₀+ℝu pointwise works. The paper's 'the 1-parameter family of parabolic isometries' is unique only up to θ ↦ cθ, and a given family P_θ is not shown to work. The SCOPE does not say that the parametrisation is chosen.
issues.fix: Say in SCOPE (c) that the family is chosen up to reparametrisation. Optionally prove that every such family is parabConj h (cθ) for some c ≠ 0, and absorb c into α.
